name: Quary
long_description:
Quary is the first analytics engineering platform that brings the entire model-test-deploy workflow into the browser. 

At our first customer, a fast-growing fintech company, Quary empowers analysts in the growth team to self-serve, contribute, and reduce reliance on the data engineering team, letting teams ship metrics faster & executives get answers sooner
one_liner: The first in-browser analytics engineering platform

launches.title: 🆀 Quary - Transform data together 🤝
launches.tagline: Stop depending on your data team and bring everyone into the data action!
launches.body:
**tl;dr: Quary connects to your data warehouse and lets your team transform raw data into valuable insights in seconds, right from your browser! Try our free trial:** [www.quary.dev](http://www.quary.dev)

\
Hey 👋. [Ben](https://linkedin.com/in/benfking) and [Louis](https://www.linkedin.com/in/louisjor/) here, we’re excited to share what we’ve been up to! [Quary](https://www.quary.dev/) is a browser-based **SQL transformation tool** that turns your raw data— whether in Snowflake, BigQuery, or DuckDB— into organized, well-documented & tested transformations.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78152&key=user_uploads/528679/2e025d53-262b-4795-823a-57dba3ba798e)

**❌ The problem**

Data engineers make up **5%** of businesses. They dig for insights for the other **95%** with predictable outcomes: siloed & overworked data teams, unshared knowledge, and delayed answers to critical business questions.

**✅ The solution**

Quary makes data engineering collaborative, sharing the responsibility across the organization. With Quary, **5%** becomes **50%**. Anyone who writes SQL can build production-grade pipelines in minutes.

**The team**

**Ben** and **Louis** here, we’re originally from Luxembourg 🇱🇺. Ben founded [Tumelo](https://www.tumelo.com) and led engineering there through its Series A. Louis survived a 4-year stint as a Software Engineer in Finance at Amazon.

**Try out our free trial:** <https://www.quary.dev>
